title: Tooling: exact integer coarse exponential with identical intervals
head: e3cd8375f6cd26393914e8395fff0d813e7031df
body:
This adds an **opt-in exact arithmetic adapter** for the retained coarse exponential. The 24-degree polynomial, geometric tail and final dyadic rounding are unchanged; common-denominator integer evaluation eliminates giant intermediate Fraction normalizations. Every returned interval is exactly the original interval.

The bottleneck was observed during the complete PR2044/PR2161 replay. This contribution starts from refreshed canonical main and leaves frozen engines, default callers and the selected certificate unchanged. **No new kappa or full supplier-admission claim.**

Validation:
- 96 exponential cases compared with both the actual unchanged engine and an independent literal polynomial/tail sum.
- 24 whole-moment comparisons, including 1000-digit endpoints and both surcharge modes.
- Eight range/profile/type/assertion-disabled rejection controls.
- Actual 30000-digit comparison against the unmodified pinned oracle; registered CPython 3.12 replay regenerates and exactly checks that committed evidence.
- Package metadata/pins, immutable-source diff, privacy and whitespace checks pass. Machine timing/hardware data and private identifiers/logs are excluded.

`PROOF.md` derives the identity for every supported exact rational input. README documents direct use, the whole-moment adapter and reproduction. The default T74 caller integration remains an explicit next question. The broad repository regression was not rerun for this scoped opt-in module; the preceding session recorded an unrelated historical split-skip source-pin failure.

Credit Douglas Colkitt and the retained PR547/548/559, ordinary-cost, mixed-supplier and T74 engine lineage; PR2044 and PR2161 provide the high-precision replay context. Source notices are preserved. Prepared under dataisfire with substantial OpenAI Codex assistance. Apache-2.0.
limits: Metadata and source identity only. Checks require source/command/coverage review; no green-badge inference.
